appearance_facts.fact: A bold title reads 'Increasing Production at Factory F from 2018 to 2023'.
A single blue line series descends continuously from left to right across the chart.
The line begins at the highest vertical position, just below the 3,500 tick.
The line ends at the lowest vertical position, between the 1,500 and 2,000 ticks.
Six evenly spaced year labels run from 2018 on the left to 2023 on the right.

public_definitions: Option 'Route to output decline response' corresponds to a downward output trend.
Option 'Route to output growth response' corresponds to an upward output trend.
Option 'Route to maintenance scheduling' is a separate follow-up route.
uncertain: The chart title states 'Increasing Production' while the plotted line clearly decreases; the title and the data geometry disagree.
Exact numeric values at each year are not labeled on the points, so values are read approximately from the y-axis gridline positions.
